name: Extra themes
description: 34 more themes from well-known editor palettes: Catppuccin Frappé, Rosé Pine Moon, the foxes, Material, Synthwave '84, Cobalt2, Modus, Iceberg, Tomorrow, Kanagawa Lotus, Flexoki and more. Colours that read poorly on their panel are nudged a little. A theme plugin is just JSON files, no code.
